snippet.title: Wordventures: The Vampire Pirate - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
On the night of the full moon, a handful of children have seemingly disappeared in the sleepy seaside town of Mistyvale Oaks. Solve word search puzzles to track down leads, uncover clues, and solve the mystery of the ghost ship in this narrative puzzle adventure game.

Wishlist now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4746360?utm_source=youtube
